# Printed by tools/abi-gen. Do not edit.
#
# <struct> <pinned member> then, for each layout, <pin> <length>:
#   p64    64-bit pointers (x86-64, ARM64, on every system)
#   p32a4  32-bit pointers, 64-bit integers 4-aligned (i386 System V)
#   p32a8  32-bit pointers, 64-bit integers 8-aligned (ARM EABI, Windows x86)
#
# The pin is where the named member ends: the length of the oldest
# version of the struct the frozen ABI publishes, and the least a
# caller may declare. It must not move. The length grows by one
# appended member at a time. A dash means the library fills that
# struct in itself and no caller ever declares one.
